name: Default road course
summary: Generic road-course profile for early braking, line setup, and exit throttle planning.

segments.name: Launch straight
segments.risk: Cold tyres can make the first heavy brake zone easy to overshoot.
segments.advice: Build speed cleanly and move to the outside before the first braking marker.

segments.name: T1 right hairpin
segments.risk: Late braking pushes the car wide and delays throttle on exit.
segments.advice: Brake in a straight line, rotate early, then wait for the wheel to open before full throttle.

segments.name: Medium left
segments.risk: Reactive steering near the edge can turn this into a track-limit warning.
segments.advice: Commit to one arc and carry minimum speed instead of adding a late steering correction.

segments.name: Back straight
segments.risk: Exit hesitation compounds into a large speed deficit before the chicane.
segments.advice: Prioritise early throttle and keep the wheel calm through the first half of the straight.

segments.name: Fast chicane entry
segments.risk: Too much entry speed forces a second steering input and hurts the left change of direction.
segments.advice: Trim speed before turn-in and keep the first kerb touch light.

segments.name: Late apex left
segments.risk: Early throttle before the late apex creates understeer and a wide exit.
segments.advice: Hold the outside entry, rotate patiently, and delay full throttle until after the apex.
